Video Maker Free for Kids — Initial Release

- Create simple, kid-friendly videos from images or clips (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 200MB)
- Fast AI processing on cloud GPUs: 30–60 seconds per video, produces 720p MP4 output
- Easy, guided workflows: upload files, give instructions, get back downloadable MP4s
- Intuitive prompt-based editing with support for text, music, and batch processing
- Automatic first-time setup, free anonymous usage with 100 credits (valid 7 days)
- Clear error handling, session management, and export process for a smooth user experience
